campaign_angle: A3 — Built Like It's Meant to Stay
hook_line: We don't just launch products. We build what lasts.

visual_identity.background: Deep navy-black (#0a0e1a), starfield with slow parallax drift
visual_identity.accent_colors: Electric cyan (#3ee6e0) to royal blue (#2e5bff) glow gradient
visual_identity.typography: Bold condensed sans-serif, uppercase for scene titles, all caps letter-spacing matching 'EMPOWER. EVOLVE. EXCELLENCE.' hero style
visual_identity.camera_style: Slow push-in, subtle parallax, no hard cuts — soft cross-dissolves between scenes
visual_identity.music: Minimal ambient synth build, low pulsing bassline that grows in intensity scene to scene

scenes.title: DESIGN
scenes.narration_voiceover: You see the product before we ever write a line of code.

on_screen_text.text: Approved before it's built. No surprises.

visual_sequence.action: The bright point from Scene 1 expands into a rough glowing wireframe grid — thin outline boxes, low-fidelity, floating in dark space.
Wireframe boxes sharpen and fill with color, gradually becoming a polished high-fidelity UI screen (app/dashboard mockup), rotating slightly in 3D as it solidifies.
Two or three UI screens fan out like an interactive prototype, a cursor/tap indicator taps between them smoothly, showing interactivity. TbPalette icon briefly overlays top corner.

scenes.sound_design: Soft synth swell as wireframe sharpens into color, subtle 'click' sfx on the cursor tap moment
scenes.transition_out: UI screens collapse into a single glowing horizontal line — matches opening shot of Scene 3

closing_frame.note: Optional 4th beat if total runtime allows 33s, otherwise fold into last 3s of Scene 3
closing_frame.on_screen_text: Cloud Insider — We Build What Lasts.
closing_frame.visual_direction: Static hold on logo + tagline + CTA over the glowing horizon, subtle star twinkle in background loop

flow_generation_notes: Generate each scene as a separate 10s clip for cleaner Flow output, then stitch with 0.5s cross-dissolve transitions.
Feed the exact hex codes (#0a0e1a background, #3ee6e0 cyan, #2e5bff blue) into every scene prompt for color consistency across generations.
Upload the actual logo file for Scene 3's final frame — don't let Flow re-generate a logo from text description.
If Flow struggles with the 'dots forming a network' concept in Scene 1, fallback prompt: 'abstract glowing constellation forming a roadmap shape on black background, cinematic, slow camera push-in.'
